subject: EOQ: priority check — Redwood / AcmeCloud
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmecloud.com>, Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Mutual Action Plan — Redwood / AcmeCloud

Hi Samir / Jenna,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the context on the migration timeline and the performance requirements for the search assist feature. Per our call, quick recap and next steps: 

- Goal: serve contextual search suggestions with end-to-end latency <150ms and keep inference cost under targets.
- What we heard: initial POC (search assist) for 3 teams, expected user volume: ~200k queries/day, target GA in Q4.
- Risk/reqs: procurement needs SOC2 evidence and a side-car VPC option for audit logging.

Mutual action plan (attached): milestones, owners, and proposed timeline. Key next steps I promised:
1) I attached the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and owners.
2) Pricing summary (see attached redwood-pricing.pdf) — included both hosted and dedicated capacity estimates.
3) SOC2 + compliance pack links (will share via the portal upon request).

Would love to lock a date for a short technical review with your infra lead next week (30 min) — does Tue 6/16 or Wed 6/17 at 10am PT work? If procurement needs something earlier, flag it and I can get our security engineer on the call.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, redwood-pricing.pdf

Best,
Aditya

Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bump: MAP + tech review availability (EOQ check)

Hi Samir —

Bumping this in case it got buried. We're approaching the end of the quarter and want to understand whether the AcmeCloud search assist initiative is still a priority for your roadmap this quarter. Two quick asks:

- Is procurement blocked on any specific doc/evidence (SOC2, DPA, SSO config)?
- Has ownership/priority shifted on the timeline for the POC?

Looping Lauren (cc'd) — she can help expedite any procurement/compliance requests or set up the architecture review with our security engineer. If it's helpful, we can do a short 15-min call to align on next steps.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ: priority check — budget/approval still on track?

Hi Samir / Jenna —

Quick EOQ ping — as we're closing the quarter I wanted to check whether the AcmeCloud search assist POC is still on track for the timeline we discussed and whether budget/approval are still aligned to start a POC in July. A few quick scenarios so we can tailor next steps:

A) Still green: procurement and infra aligned, can start POC in July (we'll prioritize kickoff and assign a TAM).
B) Budget approved but procurement needs SOC2 evidence / DPA (we can fast-track the compliance pack + onsite review).
C) Priority shifted / timing delayed — if so, could you share the new target quarter so we can adjust recommendations and hold capacity.

If you have 10–15 minutes today or tomorrow I can jump on a quick call to sync. Otherwise a one-line reply with A/B/C is perfect and I will follow up accordingly.

Thanks for the update — appreciate it as you close your quarter too.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-pricing.pdf
